scope: Exactly five curated standalone maps. Dialogues remain unchanged. Additional draft map definitions are not part of this release. Browser pixel review is separate.

campaign.missionRequirement: Every map requires clearing all ten waves and activating its core rune with a companion. Both orders work.

forest.terrain: An upper forest detour and lower entrance merge beside two large ponds. The core, supplies and root station each have an authored position; both companions start safely beside/in front of the right-hand Spire.
forest.routes: First entrance in waves 1-3, second entrance in 4-6, both from wave 7.
forest.effect: Ground enemies within 175 pixels move at 50 percent speed for 12 seconds. Flyers and enemies outside the zone are unaffected.

marsh.terrain: Four reed islands and connected boardwalks over non-walkable water, with a shared central turn and a separate eastern base island.
marsh.effect: Suppresses every Lantern Jelly healing aura for 15 seconds. Healing resumes after expiry.

wind.terrain: Five cliff islands connected by long diagonal zigzag bridges. The base sits in the northeastern corner with safe visible companion spawns.
wind.effect: The flying corridor mirrors vertically for waves 4-6, then returns. Preview and actual enemy route use the same activeAir getter.

frost.terrain: A large central frozen lake, a long northern shore route and a southern entrance that crosses the lake on an ice bridge.
frost.effect: Suppresses Frost Ram tower-disruption auras for 15 seconds. Disruption resumes after expiry.

moon.terrain: Seven separate rounded floating platforms with 80-pixel diagonal bridges share geometry with the navigation mask. Cardinal navigation uses a connected supercover through diagonal bridge cells. Both heroes start two cells beside the Spire, and the rune/cache sit on separate upper/lower plazas.
moon.effect: Portal entrances change at waves 4 and 7. The final mission progresses from northern to southern to all four portals. Sternenrichter shields at most two nearby allies.

stationRules.activation: Walk to an adjacent reachable cell, then channel for 1.2 seconds. No remote activation.
stationRules.waveEnd: Active effect clears; remaining station cooldown persists and continues during the next build phase.
stationRules.pause: Simulation updates are suspended, freezing movement, effects and cooldowns.

saveValidation.checkpoint: Most recent build phase, including economy, towers, priorities, hero positions, cooldowns, completed objectives and station uses/cooldowns.
verified: Restores immutable tower statistics from the definition ID.
Rejects malformed hero and station entries without throwing.
Rejects nonfinite, negative or fractional integer resources.
Rejects duplicate hero IDs, tower UIDs and objective IDs.
Rejects impossible tower cells, costs, levels and priorities.
Does not reset used station cooldowns on restore.
A cancelled or sold-target Mara order consumes no cooldown and causes no remote boost.
saveValidation.boundary: Local single-player saves are validated for consistency and safe loading. They are not a server-authoritative anti-cheat system.

verification.simulationTests: 53 tests pass. The suite checks the five release maps with exported renderer obstacles plus shared mechanics, arrival requirements, station cooldowns, expiry, corrupted saves, connected bridges and visible companion spawns.
verification.balance: All five authored missions won with the regular starting budget and legally built mixed defenses. Lives remaining: forest 20, marsh 20, wind 20, frost 20, Moonwatch 13. Companions reached caches and mandatory runes through actual pathfinding.
verification.sceneObstacles: scripts/check-scene.mjs exports the actual renderer blockers to tests/rendered-obstacles.json. All five missions have been replayed successfully against that export; campaign tests and the balance CLI now load it. Regenerate the export after changing scenery.
verification.visualLimit: The scene check uses a drawing-API double; it proves behavior and obstruction consistency, not final visual quality.

implementedAlternatives: The five-map release uses repeatable forest, marsh and frost stations, wind corridor changes and Moon portal changes.
There are no physically rising water levels, growing ice surfaces or player-operated route switches. Static route corridors reserve every future entrance, with the active entrance clearly previewed.
